scope: Real local-desktop Testing Research verified through Grafana on 2026-10-08 (109.653s) and 2026-10-09 after the normal-dev default-on fix (212.580s): both succeeded with Codex, each with one terminal log and seven timed steps. Prometheus cumulative count=2 and duration sum=322.233s. Persistent opt-out, remaining senders and alerts are pending. Production is untouched; this portal is not yet a live health dashboard.

phases.name: Observability stack
phases.description: Authenticated Collector, private Prometheus and Loki, and login-protected Grafana in the Stage Railway testing project.
phases.acceptance: Authenticated OTLP metric and log arrive in Prometheus and Loki; a request without a token is rejected. Grafana opens and both data sources pass health checks.

phases.name: Authenticated ingestion
phases.description: One allow-listed schema, verified Stage sessions, bounded requests, per-user rate limits and asynchronous OTLP forwarding.
phases.acceptance: Valid batch → 204 and visible data; invalid token → 401; unknown fields dropped; 101 events → 413. Counters and histograms remain correct across independent Worker requests.

phases.name: Engine runs & steps
phases.description: Bounded non-blocking queue, exactly one terminal run event, timed steps and fine-grained error kinds across workflows.
phases.acceptance: A testing research run produces one terminal event plus timed steps sharing a runId. Full/offline queues never slow or fail a run.

phases.name: Dependencies & briefs
phases.description: Instrument Details, Refero, Figma, Paper, Convex, R2 and provider CLIs. Count uploaded/loaded brief files and capture token usage and provider updates.
phases.acceptance: An invalid Details token on testing produces a dependency event and reaches a testing-only alert within five minutes. Brief upload/load counts agree with actual files.

phases.name: Desktop diagnostics
phases.description: Sidecar lifecycle, auto-update, auth and scrubbed UI errors, with a privacy opt-out and five-minute heartbeat.
phases.acceptance: Killing the engine produces a crash event. Turning diagnostics off stops both senders immediately, clears queued events and survives app restart.

phases.name: Cloud reporting
phases.description: Request latency and 5xx; authenticated Convex log streaming or server-to-server fallback; report billing and reward failures without changing their logic.
phases.acceptance: A forced Convex failure reaches Cloud within a minute. Invalid webhook/server tokens are rejected; reporting failures cannot affect billing or credit transactions.

phases.name: Dashboards & alerts
phases.description: Health, Failures, Per module, Setup friction, Cloud and Business dashboards, tested alerts, and a genuinely isolated Business reader.
phases.acceptance: Every panel has testing data. Every alert is intentionally triggered and delivered. Adrien cannot query operational logs or user ids.

Smoke passed: missing/wrong bearer 401; authenticated synthetic metric and log visible through Grafana data sources; Health dashboard provisioned. Prometheus mounted its volume and replayed WAL after redeploy. Long-term retention remains unverified.

audit.title: Complete the shared event schema
audit.change: Define provider_status, export, sidecar, desktop_update, renderer_error and auth fully; add heartbeat and cloud event types. Bound all strings, lists, numeric values and operation/model vocabularies.
audit.verification: TS/Rust schema fixtures agree. Payload limits, malformed events, unknown fields and metric label cardinality are tested.
audit.evidence: Shared contracts cover all 12 client and four server-only variants; 62 contract tests pass. Worker now strips private/unknown fields, derives identity from JWT, drops stale/wrong-channel/cloud records, caps app-version metric labels to 10 configured releases (other for the rest), and keeps ids out of metric/resource labels. 12 real-workerd/unit tests and web/data-ops typechecks pass. Six shared fixtures now verify actual Rust run/step serialization against Zod with no stripped fields; 68 contract tests pass. Remaining Rust event variants and event-to-metric coverage are pending; not verified.

audit.title: Verify identity and protect ingestion
audit.change: Verify JWT signature, issuer, audience and expiry with the existing auth configuration; derive userId from verified identity rather than trusting the payload. Authenticate cloud producers separately.
audit.verification: Invalid/expired/wrong-issuer tokens → 401; spoofed user ids cannot be attributed to another user; rate limits are durable and enforced.
audit.evidence: 2026-10-06: stage-telemetry-testing deployed as a telemetry-only Worker, route testing.getstage.co/api/telemetry; current version 73e6e0ae-66fc-4228-a0fb-8e87fad4b009 after two testing secrets were installed without printing values. No website bundle/production deployment. Public route and workers.dev alias return 401 for missing/invalid tokens and 405 for GET; shared homepage/auth remain HTTP 200. Local workerd tests cover forged/expired/wrong-issuer/audience/algorithm/missing-expiry tokens, verified user attribution and durable user limits. 2026-10-08: the real signed-in desktop Research run reached deployed Testing intake and is visible in Grafana-backed Loki/Prometheus: one successful terminal event, seven steps, run count=1 and histogram count=1/sum=109.653s. This verifies the real authenticated ingestion path, not a synthetic/local-JWT fixture. HTTP 204 was not directly captured for that desktop request. Cloud producer auth remains phase 6.

audit.title: Make OTLP counters and histograms mathematically correct
audit.change: Specify delta versus cumulative temporality for a stateless Worker, collector conversion and restart behavior. Preserve histogram buckets and exact stage_* names. Do not emit per-batch cumulative counters that reset each request.
audit.verification: Multiple requests and concurrent producers yield correct increases and quantiles with no double-counting or lost counts after a collector restart.
audit.evidence: TelemetryState owns SQLite-persisted cumulative counters/histograms with stable start times, monotonic export timestamps and serialized asynchronous snapshots. Local real-workerd tests verify exact totals/buckets for concurrent requests, persisted state after restart and recovery on the next observation after export failure. This avoids unsafe overlapping stateless deltas; existing Collector conversion must pass through cumulative inputs. scripts/smoke/telemetry.mts local-bridge mode passed against real Railway: after concurrent requests and a local Worker restart, Prometheus shows count=4, duration sum=25s and the <=5s bucket=2; matching sanitized logs are visible in Loki. All bridge metric names use stage_ingestion_smoke_* and log event ingestion_smoke, never real module-health series. This uses a local auth fixture, not a deployed signed-in Stage session. 2026-10-08: a real desktop Research run is independently visible in Prometheus history with runs_total=1, duration_count=1 and duration_sum=109.653s, matching Loki. No duplicate terminal log was found. Current instant queries are empty after inactivity because exports are event-driven; historical range queries recover the run. Collector-restart and backend quantile acceptance remain pending.

audit.title: Reconcile event rate limits with real workflows
audit.change: Estimate runs × steps × dependency calls plus status refreshes and heartbeats before committing to 600 events/user/hour. Document loss budgets and count ingestion drops without a telemetry recursion loop.
audit.verification: A realistic busy session fits the approved budget; oversized bodies reject before unbounded parsing; telemetry requests do not instrument themselves recursively.
audit.evidence: Local workerd tests enforce streamed 256 KiB UTF-8 bodies, 100 events/batch and an atomic SQLite-backed 600-received-event/user window (one hour from first admission), including concurrent arrivals and persistence after restart. Invalid/stale/channel-mismatch drops have aggregate counters; no intake middleware recursion. Export is bounded (500 queued events/20 batches, 5-second HTTP deadlines, 15-second queue age, no retries); capacity returns 503, not false acceptance. Rate state stores hashed user ids and expires after its window; metric state is capped at 20,000 series. Busy real-session loss budgets, queue saturation/expiry and window-expiry acceptance are still pending.

audit.title: Implement non-blocking engine telemetry
audit.change: Queue ≤500 events; batch at 10 seconds or 50 events; use try_send, bounded HTTP timeouts and no endless retries. Keep auth/config launch context out of event payloads.
audit.verification: Tests cover full queue, offline network, shutdown, token expiry and cancellation with no measurable run slowdown.
audit.evidence: 2026-10-06: local Research/section sender uses try_send, a 500-event waiting queue, 50-event/10-second active batches, 15-second age limit, five-second total HTTP flush, no retries or idle polling. Fixed Testing endpoint; explicit opt-in plus independent Testing channel/Convex checks. Bearers are header-only; sessions are grouped separately; no collector secret, disk spool or raw RunEvent serialization. Nine telemetry tests cover full queue, offline/closed queue, expired tokens/no retries, session separation, stale drops, concurrent terminal observations, privacy/schema parity and real worker abort/queued-credential purge. All 196 engine tests, strict Clippy and desktop typecheck pass. 2026-10-08: real local Testing desktop acceptance passed for one Codex Research run completed at 10:29:16.497 UTC, duration 109.653s. Grafana queries read back one terminal log, seven steps, Prometheus run count=1 and duration count=1/sum=109.653s. The log payload allow-list passed with no private fields. 2026-10-09: user-approved unpackaged local Testing default-on launch configuration; Electron now loads the local .env Convex URL consistently with the renderer. Eight configuration tests cover default-on, explicit opt-out, backend isolation, packaged Testing opt-in and packaged production rejection. The initial run had diagnostics disabled. After restart, the next real run completed at 17:56:45.927 UTC: Codex Research succeeded in 212.580s, one terminal Loki event and seven successful steps. Prometheus cumulative run/duration count=2 and duration sum=322.233s match the prior 109.653s plus this run. The live engine reports diagnostics enabled against the exact Testing backend. Hung-network deadline and measured busy-session slowdown remain pending.

audit.title: Instrument run lifecycle, error kinds and every step
audit.change: Reuse RunManager and workflow helpers; add provider/parse/save/brief-files timing without UI tool calls. Include pre-run context_save timing so apparently stuck starts are visible.
audit.verification: Each success/failure/cancellation emits exactly one terminal run event; failedStep points to the cause; context_save latency is visible.
audit.evidence: 2026-10-06: RunEventSink observes only allow-listed Research/section metadata; an atomic terminal guard emits at most one success/failure/cancellation observation, with total elapsed time. Existing verify-provider/stage-context/Details/Refero helpers provide bounded steps; explicit brief/provider/parse/save hooks add timing without UI tool calls or changing workflow results. Pending failed steps identify the latest cause; cancellation closes them as skipped. Provider error codes map to bounded kinds; parse failures report artifact_invalid rather than falsely implying a CLI exit. Six Rust/Zod fixtures match exactly; privacy and concurrent-terminal tests pass. Delivery remains best-effort. 2026-10-08 real-run proof: one successful Research terminal log and seven successful steps share one runId. Durations: verify-provider 82ms, stage-context 2397ms (includes brief-files 1577ms), details-context 51041ms, provider 52510ms, parse 3ms and save 2812ms; total 109653ms. Matching Prometheus run/step counters and duration histogram are visible in history. App version 0.2.55 is present in logs; unconfigured version/model/category metric labels remain other. Pre-run context_save, fine-grained dependency error kinds, model/category/usage metadata and other workflows remain pending.

audit.title: Approve honest privacy wording and policy
audit.change: Replace the claim of anonymous diagnostics or remove identifying ids. Approve metadata-only collection, EU hosting, retention and opt-out wording before release. Redaction alone does not make arbitrary error messages content-safe.

audit.title: Make opt-out immediate across both processes
audit.change: Persist preferences, stop heartbeat/senders and purge queues when disabled. Restart or reconfigure a running sidecar rather than waiting for the next launch; do not send buffered data after re-enabling.
audit.verification: Worker/device network inspection finds zero diagnostics traffic after opt-out, including an already-running engine; preference survives restart.
audit.evidence: 2026-10-06: the Testing engine now exposes disable-only POST /v1/telemetry/disable. It atomically stops producers and aborts the background worker/request, purging pending events and transport credentials without cancelling AI runs; a test exercises the actual waiting exporter and existing run scope. There is no runtime enable endpoint. Electron clamps packaged production opt-in off; Rust independently requires exact Testing deployment/channel and valid metadata. 2026-10-09: unpackaged local desktops targeting the exact Testing backend default on with user approval; STAGE_TELEMETRY_ENABLED=0 remains an explicit launch opt-out. Packaged Testing remains opt-in and packaged production stays disabled. Persistent Settings preference/UI, desktop sender/heartbeat stop, in-flight network inspection and restart/re-enable checks remain unimplemented; release is blocked.
